package.name: gz_underwater_camera
package.description: An underwater camera for Gazebo Sim: a plugin inside an rgbd_camera sensor that turns each in-air frame (colour and depth, rendered together) into what the camera sees through the world's water (gz_water_optics): the revised underwater image formation model per pixel, on linear light, with the daylight faded to each object's depth, then exposure, white balance and noise. The image library it uses is separate and Gazebo-free, so every stage is tested exactly.
